info.title: Huxley API
info.description: Huxley platform API. See https://docs.usehuxley.com for conventions.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only actions starting with this prefix, e.g. `auth.` or `org.created`.

post.summary:
Signs in with email and password. Sets the session cookie, or asks for a
second factor if the user has one.

200.description: Signed in (session cookie set), or a second factor is required

401.description: Wrong email or password, or the account is disabled or locked

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

post.summary:
Completes sign-in with a second factor. Send exactly one of `code` or
`recoveryCode`.

401.description: Wrong code, or the challenge expired or ran out of attempts

429.description: Too many attempts from this address

post.summary:
Options for answering an MFA challenge with a passkey. Finish with
`POST /api/v1/auth/login/mfa` and a `passkey` answer.

Signs in with a passkey alone. A passkey verifies the user on the device,
so no second factor is asked for.

401.description: The passkey could not be verified

post.summary: Options for passwordless sign-in with a passkey.
Signs out the current session and clears the cookie.

get.summary: Sign-in methods offered by this server.

post.summary: Replaces the recovery codes. The old ones stop working.

Starts setting up an authenticator app. Returns the secret to scan; the
app isn't required at sign-in until `/totp/confirm` succeeds.

Finishes authenticator setup with a code from the app. Returns recovery
codes (shown once) and signs out the user's other sessions.
Turns off the authenticator app and deletes recovery codes.
Finishes adding a passkey with the browser's answer.

422.description: Invalid answer, name, or expired request

post.summary: Starts adding a passkey (re-checks the password).

delete.summary:
Removes a passkey. Removing the last second factor also deletes the
recovery codes.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's password. Signs out all their other sessions.

204.description: Password changed; other sessions signed out

422.description: Current password wrong or new password too weak

delete.summary: Revokes one of the signed-in user's sessions, e.g. a lost device.

404.description: No such session for this user

get.summary: Every feature module and whether it's enabled and active.

put.summary:
Turns a feature module on or off for the instance. Data is kept when a
module is turned off.

409.description: Missing dependencies, or enabled modules depend on it

get.summary: Organizations the caller can see, ordered as a tree (parents before children).

409.description: Name already used by a sibling

post.summary: Archives an organization with no active sub-organizations.

Moves an organization and its subtree under a new parent. Requires
`org:move` on the organization and `org:create` on the new parent.
Grants a role to a user at an organization.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `nextCursor`.

post.summary: Creates a local user. The new user has no roles until one is assigned.

patch.summary: Edits a user's name or status.

get.summary: A user's role assignments that the caller can see.

delete.summary:
Removes a user's second factors (authenticator app and recovery codes) and
signs them out everywhere, for when they've lost access to both. Only an
owner can reset an owner's MFA.

204.description: MFA removed; the user signs in with a password and can set it up again

AuthMethodsView.description: Sign-in methods this server offers, for the sign-in page.

CeremonyView.description: The first half of a WebAuthn ceremony.

ceremony.description: Send back with the browser's answer.

code.description: A current six-digit code from the app.

inherit.description: Also apply to every sub-organization (default true).

password.description: Initial password. If omitted, one is generated and returned once.

generatedPassword.description: Present only when Huxley generated the password. Shown once.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the invalid field, e.g. `/name`.

name.description: A label to tell passkeys apart, e.g. "Work laptop".

code.description: A six-digit code from the authenticator app.

recoveryCode.description: One of the user's recovery codes. Each works once.

oneOf.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.
The password was right; finish with `POST /api/v1/auth/login/mfa`.

challenge.description: Pass to `/login/mfa`. Valid for a few minutes and a few attempts.

LoginResponse.description: The result of a sign-in step.

activeModules.description: Feature modules that are enabled and released.

grantedPermissions.description:
Permissions granted at any organization. For deciding what to show;
the API enforces permissions on every request regardless.

isOwner.description: Holds the Owner role at the root organization.

MeView.description: The signed-in user plus permission hints for the UI.

MfaMethodView.description: Second-factor methods offered for a challenge.

totpEnabled.description: An authenticator app is set up and required at sign-in.

phase.description: Implementation-plan phase in which the module ships.

released.description: Whether this version of Huxley includes the module.

requires.description: Modules that must be enabled for this one to work.

active.description: Enabled and released: the module is running.

ModuleState.description: A module's state for the instance.

OrgKind.description:
`provider`: the owning company, an MSP brand, or a division. `client`: a
customer of a provider, or a site/sub-org of one.

depth.description: Depth in the tree; the root is 1.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token. Send it back when updating.

PasskeyAnswer.description: The browser's answer to a passkey sign-in ceremony.

password.description: The user's current password, re-checked before the change.

recoveryCodes.description: Shown only now. Each code signs in once if the authenticator is lost.
Present when this was the user's first second factor. Shown once.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

includeDependencies.description:
When enabling, also enable any modules it requires (default false:
respond 409 listing them instead).

changed.description: Modules whose setting changed, in the order they were applied.

otpauthUri.description: `otpauth://` URI to show as a QR code.

secret.description: Base32 secret, for entering into the app by hand.

version.description: The version you last read; the update fails with 409 if it changed.

status.description: `active` or `disabled`. Disabling signs the user out everywhere.

mfaEnabled.description: Has a second factor (authenticator app) set up.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions, and the current user

tags.name: modules
tags.description: Feature modules that can be turned on or off
